kjv: none of them that trust in him (Yahweh) shall be desolate (KJV 34:22)
mine: none of those who take refuge in him (Yahweh) will be condemned
note: lo' ye'shemu "will not be held guilty" ('asham), contrasting with v.22 "those who hate the righteous will be condemned"; the KJV's "desolate" confuses 'asham with shamem.
